#include <stdint.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>

#include <node_api.h>

#ifndef NODE_API_EXPERIMENTAL_HAS_POST_FINALIZER
#error "lifecycle fixture requires node_api_post_finalizer"
#endif

#define HOLDER_MAGIC UINT64_C(0x9bf3c642881d1405)

typedef struct
{
    uint64_t magic;
    int initialized;
    int64_t accounted_bytes;
    uint64_t payload_bytes;
    unsigned char *payload;
} holder;

static uint64_t clear_count = 0;
static uint64_t post_count = 0;
static uint64_t free_count = 0;
static uint64_t fallback_free_count = 0;
static uint64_t active_bytes = 0;

static void clear_native(holder *value)
{
    if (!value->initialized)
        return;
    free(value->payload);
    value->payload = NULL;
    value->initialized = 0;
    clear_count++;
    active_bytes -= value->payload_bytes;
    value->payload_bytes = 0;
}

static void release_accounting(napi_env env, holder *value)
{
    const int64_t accounted = value->accounted_bytes;
    int64_t adjusted = 0;
    value->accounted_bytes = 0;
    if (env != NULL && accounted != 0)
        (void) napi_adjust_external_memory(env, -accounted, &adjusted);
}

static void post_finalize(napi_env env, void *data, void *hint)
{
    holder *value = (holder *) data;
    (void) hint;
    if (value == NULL || value->magic != HOLDER_MAGIC)
        return;
    release_accounting(env, value);
    value->magic = 0;
    free(value);
    post_count++;
    free_count++;
}

static void basic_finalize(
    node_api_basic_env env, void *data, void *hint)
{
    holder *value = (holder *) data;
    (void) hint;
    if (value == NULL || value->magic != HOLDER_MAGIC)
        return;
    clear_native(value);
    if (env == NULL ||
        node_api_post_finalizer(env, post_finalize, value, NULL) != napi_ok)
    {
        value->magic = 0;
        free(value);
        fallback_free_count++;
        free_count++;
    }
}

static napi_value allocate_resource(napi_env env, napi_callback_info info)
{
    napi_value argument;
    napi_value object = NULL;
    holder *value = NULL;
    size_t argc = 1;
    uint32_t bytes = 0;
    int64_t adjusted = 0;
    if (napi_get_cb_info(env, info, &argc, &argument, NULL, NULL) != napi_ok ||
        argc != 1 || napi_get_value_uint32(env, argument, &bytes) != napi_ok)
        return NULL;
    value = (holder *) calloc(1, sizeof(*value));
    if (value == NULL)
        return NULL;
    value->payload = (unsigned char *) malloc(bytes == 0 ? 1 : bytes);
    if (value->payload == NULL)
    {
        free(value);
        return NULL;
    }
    memset(value->payload, 0xa5, bytes == 0 ? 1 : bytes);
    value->magic = HOLDER_MAGIC;
    value->initialized = 1;
    value->payload_bytes = bytes;
    active_bytes += bytes;
    if (napi_create_object(env, &object) != napi_ok ||
        napi_wrap(env, object, value, basic_finalize, NULL, NULL) != napi_ok)
    {
        clear_native(value);
        value->magic = 0;
        free(value);
        free_count++;
        return NULL;
    }
    if (napi_adjust_external_memory(env, bytes, &adjusted) != napi_ok)
    {
        void *removed = NULL;
        if (napi_remove_wrap(env, object, &removed) == napi_ok &&
            removed == value)
        {
            clear_native(value);
            value->magic = 0;
            free(value);
            free_count++;
        }
        return NULL;
    }
    value->accounted_bytes = bytes;
    return object;
}

static napi_value close_resource(napi_env env, napi_callback_info info)
{
    napi_value argument;
    napi_value result;
    holder *value = NULL;
    size_t argc = 1;
    if (napi_get_cb_info(env, info, &argc, &argument, NULL, NULL) != napi_ok ||
        argc != 1 || napi_unwrap(env, argument, (void **) &value) != napi_ok ||
        value == NULL || value->magic != HOLDER_MAGIC)
        return NULL;
    clear_native(value);
    release_accounting(env, value);
    if (napi_get_undefined(env, &result) != napi_ok)
        return NULL;
    return result;
}

static int set_uint64(napi_env env, napi_value object,
    const char *name, uint64_t value)
{
    napi_value exact;
    return napi_create_bigint_uint64(env, value, &exact) == napi_ok &&
        napi_set_named_property(env, object, name, exact) == napi_ok;
}

static napi_value lifecycle_stats(napi_env env, napi_callback_info info)
{
    napi_value result;
    (void) info;
    if (napi_create_object(env, &result) != napi_ok ||
        !set_uint64(env, result, "clears", clear_count) ||
        !set_uint64(env, result, "posts", post_count) ||
        !set_uint64(env, result, "frees", free_count) ||
        !set_uint64(env, result, "fallbackFrees", fallback_free_count) ||
        !set_uint64(env, result, "activeBytes", active_bytes))
        return NULL;
    return result;
}

static napi_value initialize(napi_env env, napi_value exports)
{
    const napi_property_descriptor properties[] = {
        {"allocate", NULL, allocate_resource, NULL, NULL, NULL,
            napi_default, NULL},
        {"close", NULL, close_resource, NULL, NULL, NULL,
            napi_default, NULL},
        {"stats", NULL, lifecycle_stats, NULL, NULL, NULL,
            napi_default, NULL}
    };
    if (napi_define_properties(env, exports,
            sizeof(properties) / sizeof(properties[0]), properties) != napi_ok)
        return NULL;
    return exports;
}

NAPI_MODULE(NODE_GYP_MODULE_NAME, initialize)
